reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that adds an RPG-style encounter system to conversations: it listens to turn completion, conditionally triggers random events, updates a persistent character profile, and exposes configuration and status tools, making it a chat-facing plugin-development/automation extension rather than a utility-only tool.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，在对话结束后按条件触发随机奇遇，并持续更新可查看的主角属性与等级状态，同时提供设置页和工具供用户控制与查询。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that triggers probabilistic encounter events after chat turns, updates a persistent character profile with levels and attributes, and provides settings plus status tools for user control.

capabilities: Injects optional follow-up narrative content into chat flows after selected turns
Maintains persistent per-character attributes and level in plugin storage
Provides user-configurable behavior via a dedicated DSH settings page and API route
Registers tools for querying and resetting character status

reasons.code: turn-end trigger and user-turn filtering to avoid self-loop
cross-session character persistence via storage domain with in-memory fallback
settings page + custom route + tools for runtime control
dsh plugin manifest and UI/runtime modules indicate host integration
